nodes.name: Hydrothermal synthesis of FCCMC LDHs
nodes.procedure: Equimolar quantities (0.45 mmol each) of Fe(NO3)3·9H2O, Cu(NO3)2·6H2O, Co(NO3)2·6H2O, Mn(NO3)2·6H2O, and Cr(NO3)3·9H2O were dissolved in 40 mL of deionized water along with 10 mmol of urea. The solution was stirred for 1 h, after which the pH was adjusted to 10 using 1M NaOH and 1M Na2CO3. The resulting mixture was then transferred into a 100 mL Teflon-lined stainless-steel autoclave and heated at 180°C for 12 h. After natural cooling to room temperature, the precipitate was washed thoroughly with deionized water and ethanol, followed by drying in an oven at 60°C for 12 h. This process yielded the FeCoCrMnCu (FCCMC) LDHs.

In this setup, the working electrode consisted of nickel foam (NF) coated with the LDHs catalyst, a Hg/HgO electrode acted as the reference, and a platinum wire served as the counter electrode in 1.0 M KOH solution at room temperature... FCCMC achieving 295 mV at η₁₀... Tafel slope of 119.5 mVdec⁻¹... maintained stable OER activity over 74 h at a current density of 10 mA cm⁻²... FCCMC LDHs had the highest C_dl value of 0.00374 mF/cm², which corresponds to an ECSA of 0.0935 cm²

nodes.characterization_summary: All samples showed diffraction peaks matching LDH phase (JCPDS 050-0235) with (003) peak shifting from 11.6° in FCC to 11.4° in FCCM and 11.1° in FCCMC, indicating lattice distortion.
nodes.evidence_snippet: All synthesized samples showed diffraction peaks matching the LDH phase, consistent with JCPDS card no. 050-0235. In the FCC sample, distinct peaks appeared at 2θ values of 11.6°, 23.4°, 34.0°, 38.7°, 46.2°, and 60.5° corresponding to (003), (006), (012), (015), (018), and (113) crystal planes, respectively.

nodes.characterization_summary: FE-SEM reveals uniform distribution of LDHs on nickel foam; FCC shows loosely arranged spherical particles, FCCM moderately compact spheres, FCCMC tightly packed uniform nanoparticles.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Figure 2 shows the FE-SEM images of three LDHs samples coated on the nickel foam, revealing uniform distribution of the LDHs samples.

properties.features: High-resolution image showing particle morphology and agglomeration

nodes.characterization_summary: FCCMC shows sheet-shaped nanostructures and nanoparticles with high crystallinity; lattice fringes show (012) plane with d-spacing of 0.263 nm; FCC and FCCM show similar high crystallinity and uniform elemental incorporation.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Figure 3 shows the results of TEM characterization for high-entropy FCCMC LDHs sample. ... The line spacing profile in Figure 3d associated with the interplanar spacing of (012) with d spacing of 0.263 nm.

nodes.characterization_summary: Elemental mapping reveals even incorporation of Fe, Co, Cr, Mn, Cu in FCCMC LDHs.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Figure 3e shows the elemental mapping of as-synthesized FCCMC LDHs sample, revealing that all elementals (Fe, Co, Cr, Mn, Cu) were evenly incorporated in the LDHs catalyst.

nodes.characterization_summary: Element ratios are approximately equimolar for FCC, FCCM, and FCCMC samples.
nodes.evidence_snippet: All three LDH samples were examined for chemical composition using an inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometry (ICP-MS) equipment (Figure S3, Supporting Information). The results show that the element ratios are approximately equimolar for all three samples.

nodes.characterization_summary: Fe 2p confirms Fe³⁺ at 711.5 eV (2p3/2) and 724.5 eV (2p1/2); Co 2p shows Co²⁺/Co³⁺ with binding energy shifts to higher values and increased Co²⁺/Co³⁺ ratio in FCCMC; Cr 2p confirms Cr³⁺ at 576.4/586.2 eV; Mn 2p shows Mn²⁺/Mn³⁺ at 641.6/643.6 eV; Cu 2p confirms Cu²⁺ at 933.8/954.4 eV; O 1s shows OV ratio 0.68 in FCCMC (highest).
nodes.evidence_snippet: The existence of Fe³⁺ in all compositions is confirmed by the Fe 2p XPS spectra of FCC, FCCM, and FCCMC in Figure 4a, which show characteristic Fe³⁺ features, including spin-orbit peaks at 711.5 eV (Fe 2p3/2) and 724.5 eV (Fe 2p1/2)... The calculated Co²⁺/Co³⁺ surface ratio, based on the fitted peak areas, is highest for FCCMC... O 1s spectrum... relative intensity ratio of OV increases from 0.61 in FCC LDHs to 0.68 in FCCMC counterpart.

nodes.characterization_summary: Chemical composition analysis confirms approximately equimolar ratios of elements in FCC, FCCM, and FCCMC LDHs.
nodes.evidence_snippet: All three LDH samples were examined for chemical composition using an inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometry (ICP-MS) equipment (Figure S3, Supporting Information). The results show that the element ratios are approximately equimolar for all three samples, indicating high accuracy and controllability of the synthesis process.
